query_text: Imagine that instead of presidential debates, we had rap battles. Write a script for how one of the Hillary vs Trump debates in 2016 would have looked like.

parts.text:
**(The scene is the Hofstra University debate hall, September 2016. Instead of podiums, there is a central stage with two standing microphones. In the background, a live DJ is spinning a classic, heavy 90s boom-bap beat. The crowd is packed, buzzing with anticipation.)**

**MC LESTER HOLT:**  
*(Walking to the center of the stage, wearing a gold chain over his suit)*  
Welcome to the main event! No policy papers, no rules of order, just two candidates, one mic each, and ninety seconds to spit. We tossed a coin backstage, and Donald Trump, you won the toss. You’ve got the floor first. DJ, drop the beat!

*(The DJ drops a heavy, driving beat. The crowd roars.)*

**DONALD TRUMP:**  
*(Grabs the mic, paces the stage, does a signature hand gesture, sniffs)*  
Yeah. Look at her, folks. So tired. So weak.  
I’m about to lay it down, make 'em gasp when I speak.  
You’ve been in Washington for thirty long years,  
And all you brought the people was disaster and tears!  
I’m a self-made giant, a billionaire boss,  
While you’re running a campaign that's a total, sad loss.  
I’m gonna build a wall, it’s gonna be tall,  
And Mexico’s paying, yeah, we’re taking it all!  
Your energy’s low, you need a nap on the stage,  
I’m a political outsider turning the page.  
You’re controlled by Wall Street, eating out of their hand,  
While I’m gonna Make America Great Again!  
*(Crowd cheers. Trump sniffs again and points at Hillary)*  
*Wrong!* You got nothing, Hillary! Nothing!

**MC LESTER HOLT:**  
*(Stepping in)*  
Time! Clean bars, heavy hits. Secretary Clinton, the mic is yours. Rebuttal!

**HILLARY CLINTON:**  
*(Smiles, does a quick shoulder shimmy, steps up with poise)*  
Donald, you talk big, but your pockets are light,  
Won’t release your tax returns? What’s kept out of sight?  
You inherited millions, then went bankrupt six times,  
Leaving workers unpaid—now those are real crimes!  
You want to build walls? I’m breaking glass ceilings,  
You govern by Twitter and fragile white feelings.  
I’ve got the receipts, the plans, and the grit,  
While you’re a reality TV host throwing a fit.  
I’ve been in the Situation Room, dealing with crises,  
While you were writing tweets and complaining 'bout prices.  
You’re a threat to democracy, a loose cannon spark,  
And your "great" brand of business is a walk in the dark!  
*(Crowd goes "OHHHHHHHHH!")*

**DONALD TRUMP:**  
*(Interrupted, leaning into his mic)*  
Not true! Totally fake!

**MC LESTER HOLT:**  
Hold on, hold on! Round Two! Trump, you’ve got the mic. Let’s hear about the foreign policy and the emails. Go!

**DONALD TRUMP:**  
*(Smirking, pacing aggressively)*  
She wants to talk business? Let's talk about your past!  
Thirty-three thousand emails deleted so fast!  
Where are they, Hillary? What did they say?  
If I was in charge, you’d be locked up today!  
Our country is bleeding, our jobs are in China,  
You’re selling us out to the highest design-a!  
The Clinton Foundation’s a pay-to-play scheme,  
You ruined the country, you destroyed the dream.  
You backed the Iraq War, ISIS arose,  
You’re a puppet for the globalists, everyone knows!  
I’ve got the best words, the biggest brain, too,  
The only thing "crooked" in this room is *you*!  
*(Trump drops the mic to his hip, nodding, soaking in the cheers)*

**HILLARY CLINTON:**  
*(Picking up her mic instantly, stepping closer to Trump)*  
A puppet? That’s rich, coming straight from your mouth,  
When you’re bowing to Putin and heading down south.  
You praise dictators, you threaten our allies,  
Your entire campaign is built upon lies.  
*(Trump interrupts off-mic: "No puppet! No puppet! You're the puppet!")*  
Let's talk Trump University—a scam and a fraud,  
You preyed on the poor while you traveled abroad.  
You insult our veterans, you demean women’s lives,  
But when the heat gets turned up, your courage deprives.  
I’ve got ninety-nine policies, and they’re all fully planned,  
You couldn’t find Syria on a physical map of the land.  
So go back to your tower, your gold-plated seat,  
Because this is one battle you’re going to meet!  
*(Hillary finishes with a confident nod, staring Trump dead in the eye)*

**MC LESTER HOLT:**  
*(Stepping between them as the beat fades out, holding his hands up)*  
And that’s time! The mics are hot, the crowd is wild! 

We’ve had the boasts, we’ve had the roasts, now it’s up to the voters to decide who dropped the better track. 

America, vote! Holt, out!
